newsitem.title: ITALY: IRI net debt at 3.6 trln lire -chairman.
newsitem.headline: IRI net debt at 3.6 trln lire -chairman.

text.p: Italian state industry holding IRI SpA had net debt at end-June of some 3.6 trillion lire, Chairman Gian Maria Gros-Pietro said on Wednesday.
The figure "is in complete accordance with commitments made to the European Union", on reducing IRI's debt, Gros-Pietro told the lower house Senate's industry commission.
The EU executive Commission had given the Italian government until the end of June to cut IRI's debt to below five trillion lire.
